title: You forms questionnaire
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y8 lesson 6 (Pupil PDF worksheet: you forms questionnaire)
intro: Lesson 6: Present tense with 'you': تَأْكُلُ، تَأْكُلِينَ. To understand how present-tense verbs change for 'you' when talking to a boy or a girl

questions.model: Teacher: remove يَـ, add تَـ: تَكْتُبُ for a boy; for a girl add ـِينَ: تَكْتُبِينَ.

questions.q: Questionnaire on the pupil PDF: write six questions to a boy and six to a girl about routines (eat, drink, study, sleep, read, pray); then answer three of them about yourself with أَنَا forms.
questions.a: Correct تَـ and تَـ ... ـِينَ forms; correct أَ forms in answers
questions.model: Teacher writes: مَاذَا تَأْكُلُ فِي الفَطُورِ؟ / مَاذَا تَأْكُلِينَ فِي الفَطُورِ؟ آكُلُ خُبْزًا وَجُبْنًا.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: how does the change help?
questions.a: It shows clearly who is spoken to
